summary: This is the output of the Library program: three book titles held in a List<String> and printed one per line by a for loop.

lines.text: The first title added to the list is the first one printed, because a List keeps its elements in insertion order rather than sorting or shuffling them.
Each title lands on its own line because the loop body uses println, which appends a newline after every element.
The loop stops here on its own: a for-each loop walks the list until it runs out of elements, so you never have to track how many titles you added.
